candidates.source_name: Clarity Project — аналітична платформа перевірки компаній та закупівель
candidates.why_relevant: Aggregates 140+ state registries plus full Prozorro tender/contract data into per-company dossiers. Lets you pivot from a single bank contract to a vendor's entire customer portfolio, its owners, AMCU cases and DASU monitoring. Contract and tender listings are filterable by tenderer/contractor, which is the fastest way to enumerate equipment and IT suppliers that have sold to state-owned banks.
candidates.access_status: partially free web access; deeper analytics and exports behind paid licence (Clarity App)
candidates.legal_status: commercial service redistributing Ukrainian open data; ToS restricts bulk scraping
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/licensed search of company and contract pages; prefer paid licence or API over scraping. Seed with EDRPOU codes of known POS/ATM/IT vendors and of state banks.
queries_used: Clarity Project договори банку постачальник обладнання тендери

candidates.source_name: YouControl — досьє на компанії України
candidates.why_relevant: De-facto compliance standard used by Ukrainian banks themselves. Builds a dossier per legal entity/FOP from 220+ open sources: ownership, beneficiaries, KVED classification, court decisions, licences, tenders, connection graphs. KVED catalogues (e.g. payment-system and IT services codes) directly enumerate candidate vendors and competitors.
candidates.access_status: freemium; full dossiers and KVED catalogues require subscription
candidates.legal_status: commercial licence; API (YouScore) is the sanctioned automation route
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Subscription + YouScore API for structured pulls; use KVED and connection-graph views to snowball actor lists.
queries_used: YouControl компанія КВЕД платіжні системи контрагенти банків аналітика

candidates.source_name: YouControl — page listing its 220+ underlying data sources
candidates.why_relevant: A published inventory of the Ukrainian registries and datasets that aggregators consume. Effectively a ready-made map of upstream primary sources for the whole workstream — use it to discover registries this cell has not yet covered.
candidates.access_status: open web page
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off fetch and parse into a registry catalogue; re-check quarterly.

candidates.source_name: Opendatabot — відкриті дані про компанії, ФОП, суди, нерухомість
candidates.why_relevant: Aggregates 30+ Ukrainian open datasets with both a consumer interface and a documented commercial API. Supplies monitoring data into BI Prozorro. Good for automated counterparty checks by EDRPOU, change monitoring on vendor entities, and litigation signals (vendor vs bank disputes).
candidates.access_status: freemium; API keys paid
candidates.legal_status: commercial redistribution of open data under its own ToS
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Licensed REST API (JSON) keyed on EDRPOU; set up change-monitoring subscriptions for tracked vendors.
queries_used: Opendatabot API тендери реєстр судові рішення банк постачальник

candidates.source_name: OpenDataBot API developer documentation
candidates.why_relevant: Technical contract for programmatic access — endpoints, fields and coverage for EDR, court register, debtors register and related datasets. Determines what can be collected at scale and at what granularity.
candidates.access_status: open documentation; API requires key
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Read once to design ingestion schema; re-check on version changes.

candidates.source_name: Opendatabot Court — Єдиний державний реєстр судових рішень (ЄДРСР) пошук
candidates.why_relevant: Searchable front-end over the unified court-decisions register. Litigation between a bank and a supplier is often the only public trace of a contract that was never announced — judgments frequently name contract numbers, equipment models and amounts.
candidates.access_status: free search, paid API for bulk
candidates.legal_status: public judicial data (personal data redacted by the register)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword + party-name search (bank names, vendor names, 'постачання обладнання', 'банкомат', 'POS-термінал'); API for systematic pulls.
queries_used: Opendatabot API тендери реєстр судові рішення банк постачальник

candidates.source_name: Єдиний державний реєстр юридичних осіб, ФОП та громадських формувань (ЄДР) — Мін'юст
candidates.why_relevant: The primary registry every aggregator resells: legal name, EDRPOU, KVED activity codes, directors, founders/beneficiaries, capital, status. Authoritative ground truth for identifying and de-duplicating vendor entities before linking them to contracts.
candidates.access_status: free basic search; full extract ~90 UAH and requires qualified e-signature login
candidates.legal_status: official public register; extracts are a paid state service
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Free search for identity confirmation; use aggregators/API for scale rather than the portal (session-based, e-signature gated).

candidates.source_name: VKURSI.PRO — перевірка компаній, ФОП і відкритих даних
candidates.why_relevant: Third major Ukrainian counterparty-intelligence platform (70+ sources): tender history by period, court decisions, sanctions, financial analytics, trademarks, plus a connection-finder linking companies by shared directors/founders/addresses. Segmentation by KVED and region makes it usable to build vendor and competitor longlists.
candidates.access_status: subscription; documented API
candidates.legal_status: commercial; states it is an official provider of access to state registers
candidates.suggested_collection_method: API (documented on GitHub) for company/tender pulls; UI for connection-graph exploration.

candidates.source_name: Prozorro central procurement database (public API)
candidates.why_relevant: The upstream primary source behind every Ukrainian tender aggregator: full tender, award and contract records for state-owned banks and other public buyers, open via API. The canonical way to evidence which vendor supplied what to which bank, at what price.
candidates.access_status: open API, no registration for read access
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Incremental API crawl filtered by buyer EDRPOU (state banks) and CPV/ДК021 codes for ATMs, POS terminals, IT services; archive raw JSON.

candidates.why_relevant: Free Qlik-based analytics over all Prozorro procurement since 2015, refreshed daily, enriched with state-register data and Opendatabot monitoring. candidates.legal_status: public tool by DOZORRO/TI Ukraine ecosystem

candidates.why_relevant: Civil-society monitoring layer over Prozorro (Transparency International Ukraine). Publishes tools, methodologies and investigations naming specific suppliers and buyers — a pointer both to analytical instruments and to case studies of contested bank/state procurement.

negative_findings.description: No Ukrainian aggregator was found that indexes contracts of PRIVATE (non-state-owned) banks. Prozorro, spending.gov.ua and the aggregators built on them cover public buyers and state/communal enterprises only; private bank–vendor contracts surface only indirectly (litigation, commercial tender boards, vendor press releases).
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in uk and en for private/commercial bank procurement disclosure returned only commercial tender marketplaces (SmartTender, E-Tender, Zakupivli24), not a contract register.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Supplier mapping for private banks — the majority of the Ukrainian banking market by count — cannot be done from aggregators alone and needs litigation and commercial-tender triangulation.

negative_findings.description: The three main aggregators (Clarity Project, YouControl, VKURSI) all gate their most valuable views — full dossiers, KVED catalogues, connection graphs, exports — behind paid subscriptions, and their ToS restrict bulk automated collection.
negative_findings.result_summary: Free tiers confirmed to exist but with limited fields; licensed API products (YouScore, Opendatabot API, VKURSI API, Clarity App licence) identified as the sanctioned route.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget and licensing decisions are a prerequisite for systematic collection in this cell; scraping is a legal and continuity risk.

negative_findings.description: No page in this cell was fetched directly; all findings come from search-result metadata and snippets. URLs are provided with confidence scores but liveness is unverified.
negative_findings.result_summary: Registry portals such as usr.minjust.gov.ua are known to be session- and e-signature-gated and are likely to appear unreachable to automated fetchers without being dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream liveness checks should not mark e-signature-gated or bot-defended registry portals as dead on a single failed fetch.

coverage_gaps.description: Antimonopoly Committee (АМКУ) decision database and the DASU procurement-monitoring register were referenced as inputs to Clarity Project but were not located as standalone primary sources in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search 'АМКУ рішення оскарження закупівлі реєстр' and 'Держаудитслужба моніторинг закупівель' and add the primary portals; complaint decisions name losing bidders and thus competitors.

coverage_gaps.description: Beneficial-ownership and sanctions/PEP layers (e.g. Ukrainian sanctions registers, NAZK war-sponsors list) were only mentioned as aggregator features, not scouted as sources in their own right.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout the standalone sanctions/PEP registers so vendor entities can be screened without a paid aggregator.

coverage_gaps.description: Russian-language variants of key terms (постачальник/поставщик, закупки, контрагент) were not used; some legacy Ukrainian corporate and court content is still Russian-language.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-run core queries with ru transliterations against the same portals to catch pre-2022 documents.

coverage_gaps.description: No check was made of whether international aggregators (OpenCorporates, OpenSanctions, Open Contracting Partnership mirrors) carry Ukrainian EDR/Prozorro data in a licence-friendlier form.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test OpenSanctions and OpenCorporates coverage of Ukrainian EDR entities as a bulk-friendly alternative to domestic paid platforms.

brief: Ukraine has an unusually rich corporate- and contract-transparency layer: three commercial aggregators (Clarity Project, YouControl, VKURSI.PRO) plus Opendatabot resell searchable views over the state registry (ЄДР), the court-decisions register (ЄДРСР) and the full Prozorro procurement database, all of which are also reachable directly and free via prozorro.gov.ua's API, spending.gov.ua contract disclosures and data.gov.ua datasets. For state-owned banks this makes vendor-to-client mapping close to a solved problem — a supplier's entire public-sector portfolio, owners and litigation history can be traced from one contract. The hard boundary is private banks, whose supplier relationships appear in no register; there the only public traces are commercial tender marketplaces (SmartTender, E-Tender, PrivatBank's Zakupivli24), Prozorro.Sale liquidation lots, and court judgments naming contracts. Practical constraint: the highest-value aggregator views are subscription-gated with anti-scraping terms, so collection should be designed around licensed APIs (YouScore, Opendatabot, VKURSI) and the free Prozorro/spending/data.gov.ua primaries.
